DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis.

The imaging results showing joint space narrowing and osteophyte formation in the hip and knee are consistent with osteoarthritis. The normal uric acid level and lack of inflammatory markers further support this diagnosis over gout or rheumatoid arthritis. I will proceed with a management plan focused on pain control and physical therapy.
